definitions.explanation: a premium railway car on Japanese trains offering more comfortable seating and less crowding for an additional fare

examples.japanese: グリーン{車|しゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I rode in the first-class car.

examples.japanese: グリーン{車|しゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空|す}いて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧だ。
examples.english: The first-class car is empty and comfortable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グリーン{車|しゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
examples.english: The seats in the Shinkansen first-class car are spacious.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From 「グリーン」 (green) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (car)
The name comes from the green clover symbol used to mark these cars.

FEATURES:
- Larger, more comfortable seats
- More legroom
- Less crowding
- Additional fare required (グリーン⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧)

FORMS:
- ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グリーン{車|しゃ} - Shinkansen first class
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧グリーン{車|しゃ} - First class on local trains
- グラン⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧ - super first class (even higher tier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グリーン{車|しゃ} ↔ ⟦{普通車|ふつうしゃ}→普通車：20940_futsuusha⟧ (regular car)
- グリーン{車|しゃ} ↔ ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧ (unreserved seating)
